description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex, email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex and private prepared MIME representation if needed. Reuse shared FileSettings/TransportRequirements; select actual outbound SMTP connector for IMAP-origin replies, freezing sender/config/envelope. Extend existing preparation/submission seam, not a new email lifecycle. Advertise send_with_attachments only with working implementation.
Approved behavior: measure fully encoded MIME and submit that representation; final thread/continuation header changes require re-encoding/revalidation. Disable transport retries. Relay acceptance confirms submission only. Current Swoosh 1.27.0/gen_smtp 1.3.0 match reference, but verify exact wire framing and supported API before reusing version-sensitive code. No credential/prepared-byte telemetry. Malformed payloads cannot read paths/URLs.
Prepare all direct-send candidates before publication under abort. Continue keeps usable files or original text when none prepare, retaining failures. Requirements-error continue text fallback requires valid text connection and its limits, with zero file acquisition. Apply approved sequential abort, continue concurrency/root policy and configurable 30s operation deadlines through shared executor. Earlier confirmed email survives later failure.
Tests before implementation: exact boundary and one-byte overflow, final-header overflow before submission, measured versus submitted MIME bytes including CRLF framing, selected SMTP for IMAP, same sender/envelope/config across attempt, filenames/MIME/binary bytes, preparation-all-before-submit, text-only fallback and no unrestricted fallback, partial submissions, no retries, connection isolation, malformed prepared payload, callback/history outage without resend.
Branches: abort/continue, text/files, configuration/preparation/SMTP reject/timeout, partial confirmations.
Mocking: external SMTP/local capture only; keep real encoding and internal boundaries, per-call runtime config.
Documentation: SmtpSender/EmailBridge module docs and Channels guide.
Action reuse: extend SmtpSender/EmailBridge, reuse shared settings/resolver, task supervision and normalized outcomes. Infrastructure local-only, no new Action. No replacement PR2 settings or PR7 notification wiring.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

PR #970 integration regression requirement (2026-11-27): SMTP continues to expose configurable file controls while file delivery itself is unsupported. Enabling real SMTP attachment capability in PR5 makes declared required limits applicable; previously saved incomplete settings must fail requirements resolution and follow approved selected-connection abort/continue fallback, never silently gain fabricated limits. Preserve settings.file_delivery.send_on_file_failure=false across save/reload and execution. Use current EmailConnectorSettings persistence/error projections, including evaluated capabilities metadata; do not restore old SMTP settings or consume cached rejected-save facts as execution configuration. Exact MIME and selected SMTP semantics are unchanged.

comments.text: Moved to PR5 per Jad seven-PR split. Not part of feat/delivery_plan PR4. Existing functional/test/reuse specification retained. Executor prerequisite and PR5 review/coverage finalization must be planned before implementation.

User explicitly approved the scoped existing SMTP contract-test update on 2026-11-28: replace blanket SMTP/IMAP unsupported expectations with valid selected outbound SMTP support plus incomplete-settings failure coverage. Web providers remain unsupported. Source: asynchronous question and user answer Approve this scoped SMTP contract-test update. No other test behavior changes or UX approval inferred.

Boundary audit/reuse: EmailBridge owns reply subject/threading and selected SMTP receipt; SmtpSender owns pure Swoosh composition, credentials/TLS options and external SMTP submission; shared Preparation/Executor owns acquisition, grouping, policy and deadlines. Extend existing composition rather than add another mail lifecycle. File callback receives frozen actual outbound SMTP connection and never resolves notification defaults or rereads settings. Prepare once per final body/headers, submit exact encoded body through gen_smtp with retries=0, relay acceptance only. Local TCP capture is the sole external fixture. Existing send_notification text behavior remains on Mailer. Required positive count/encoded limits activate SMTP file mode; IMAP snapshot itself cannot substitute inbox settings for SMTP.

Additional approval received 2026-11-28: user approved the exact SMTP snapshot and no-file property updates in email_bridge_test.exs plus explicit valid count/MIME-size limits in SMTP test fixtures. Existing text/routing/encryption/envelope assertions must stay intact. Approval source asynchronous answer Approve these scoped SMTP test updates. This extends earlier delivery_contract_test approval only; no UX/E2E approval inferred.

SMTP implementation validated: frozen selected settings/envelope, shared legacy composition, private non-inspectable PreparedMessage, exact encoded MIME measured and submitted, retries=0/no MX routing and no opportunistic TLS reconnect. Final root/continuation headers re-encode and revalidate. Explicit negative acknowledgment -> failed/rejected; dropped acknowledgment -> unconfirmed; neither retries. SMTP requires count and MIME limits; IMAP itself remains unsupported until actual SMTP selection in later API task. Approved fixture/snapshot/property updates preserve text/routing/encryption/envelope assertions. Validation: 402 tests passed (19 properties), mix q passed. Selection through API and downstream reporting-outage checks follow dependent tasks; no publication/pins/overrides.
